# Intake Brief: Critical repo wipe by destructive 'init' commit — test-isolation failure

## Problem Statement

The test fixture `TestRootFileOnlyRepoManifest._init_repo` in `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` executed against the live repository root instead of its designated `tmp_path`, producing commit `2c30dbfe` ("init") that deleted 472 files / 138,007 lines. The local `dev` branch was corrupted by a fast-forward pull of this commit. The live checkout has been recovered, the fixture has been guarded, and the destructive commit is now unreachable from all local refs.

## Users & User Stories

- **Agent/operator:** "When tests run in a loaded multi-agent environment, test fixtures must never be able to commit into the live repository — I need the test suite to fail safely, not silently destroy code."
- **Team:** "After a test-isolation incident, the repo must be recoverable with minimal manual intervention, and a guard must exist to prevent recurrence."

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Local `dev` branch restored to full repository tree** — verified by `git rev-parse HEAD` pointing at a valid commit on `origin/dev` and `git status` clean.
- **Destructive commit `2c30dbfe` unreachable from any local branch** — verified by `git for-each-ref --contains 2c30dbfe` returning empty.
- **Test-isolation guard added to `TestRootFileOnlyRepoManifest._init_repo`** — the fixture now asserts `tmp_path` is not inside a git repository before executing `git init`; a regression test `test_init_repo_refuses_live_repo_tmp_path` verifies this guard.
- **Full project test suite passes** with the new changes.
- **All related documentation is updated** to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.

## Constraints

- The guard must not break legitimate uses of `_init_repo` with isolated tmp dirs.
- Recovery steps must not disturb other agents' worktrees or local branches (other than the corrupted `dev` on the main checkout).
- The destructive commit must be completely pruned from local refs.

## Existing State

- `origin/dev` was clean at `74bd0437` when the incident was detected; the damage was local-only.
- The fixture's placeholder filenames (`install.sh`, `remote`, `sshl`, `update`, `ai.home.conf`, `tests/test_a.py`) and git identity (`T <t@t.com>`, commit message "init") exactly matched commit `2c30dbfe`.
- Recovery was executed by resetting `dev` to `origin/dev` (reflog confirms `74bd0437 dev@{7}: branch: Reset to origin/dev`).
- The fixture isolation guard (SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42) was implemented and verified.

## Key Files

- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` — Guard at lines 495-535: `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` check with `AssertionError` on live repo root; regression test at line 606.
- `skill/audit/tests/test_audit_runner_launch_context.py` — Class docstring updated with incident context.

## Related Work

- **SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42**: "Dangerous test fixture: TestRootFileOnlyRepoManifest._init_repo can commit against the live repo" — completed/in_review, all 3 ACs met, guard + regression test delivered (commit `127e2ec5`).
- **SA-0MU8CD4V3002WL7N**: "skill/plan/tests/test_plan_helpers.py failing tests" — completed/in_review (pre-existing failures now closed).
- **SA-0MU0X9CRI009QKKK**: "Quality Improvement - Refactoring" — open/plan_complete; the stale worktree branch that held 2c30dbfe has been re-pointed.
- **SA-0MU7KKJSW006AD5D**: "[test-failure] TestBudgetExhaustionRecording" — parent item, blocked (pre-existing condition, unrelated to recovery).

## Risks & Assumptions

- **Scope**: This item covers incident recovery and the test-isolation guard. The fixture change is delivered via SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42.
- **Assumption**: All related documentation (class docstring, code comments) was updated as part of SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42.
- **Risk**: A similar test-isolation vulnerability may exist in other fixtures. This is a separate investigation opportunity.
- **Scope creep**: Additional fixtures should be audited separately; this item covers `_init_repo` only.

## Appendix: Clarifying Questions & Answers

- Q: "Authorise local main-checkout reset to `origin/dev`?" — A: Recovery already executed by another agent; reflog confirms `git checkout -B dev origin/dev` at 74bd0437. Source: local git reflog.
- Q: "Should the fixture change be handled here or via a separate work item?" — A: Handled via separate item SA-0MU8EKJYY007PT42, now completed/in_review. Guard + regression test verified.
- Q: "Was the destructive commit ever pushed to a shared remote branch other than dev/main?" — A: Verified via `git for-each-ref --contains 2c30dbfe` — no refs contain the commit. `origin/dev` and `origin/main` are clean.


## Plan: Changelog

- **2026-09-21T** — Plan skill: decomposed into 3 children (Verify & harden, Full suite verification, Documentation audit); added dependency (Full suite → Verify). Ran six automated review stages (all passed). Improved child AC phrasing for coverage tool traceability. AC coverage: 100% (proceed).

# Audit runner: pre-review child with `inherited_pass` bypasses children-stage block and summary claims "all children in in_review/done"

Discovered during the audit of `CG-0MTV69NII000LW8I` (Tableau-Card-Engine) — `discovered-from:CG-0MTV69NII000LW8I`.

## Problem Statement
The audit runner can report **"Ready to close: Yes"** for a parent work item that has a **critical, pre-review-stage child** (e.g. an auto-triaged `test-failure` item at `intake_complete`), and the report summary falsely claims *"All children are in in_review or done stage."* This produces a false-positive closure verdict.

## Evidence (reproduction)
- Audited item: `CG-0MTV69NII000LW8I` (Tableau-Card-Engine), audit run 2026-09-20.
- The runner auto-executed the full suite (F3 cache-miss path). The unit vitest stage was **SIGKILLed (exit 137)**.
- The test skill triaged this into `CG-0MUA2UWY7002KUQR` — a **critical `test-failure` bug** created as a **child** of the audited item at `status: open`, `stage: intake_complete`.
- The runner then reported `Ready to close: Yes` with summary: *"All children are in in_review or done stage."*
- The persisted report's `## Children Status` **does** render the child as `CG-0MUA2UWY7002KUQR — open/intake_complete` with verdict `met` ("Inherited from parent pass") — directly contradicting the summary.

## Root Cause
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` (~9855-9861, `if not parent_gaps:` branch): when the parent passes with no gaps, **every** child gets `cr["inherited_pass"] = True` and `cr["child_audit_ready"] = True` — with **no stage guard**. The only guard is `_child_content_changed`, which is false for a brand-new child.
- `audit_runner.py:4207`: `all_children_reviewed = all(c.get("stage") in ("in_review","done") or c.get("inherited_pass") ...)` — `inherited_pass` exempts a **pre-review** child from the blocking children-stage check.
- `audit_runner.py:4333`: the summary unconditionally appends *"All children are in in_review or done stage."* when `all_children_reviewed` is true, even when a child is actually at `intake_complete`/`idea`/`plan_complete`.

## Expected Behaviour
- A child in a pre-review stage (`idea`, `intake_complete`, `plan_complete`) MUST block parent closure, per the documented rule ("only pre-review stages block") and `SA-0MRL8W6V7006LH5I`.
- `inherited_pass` (parent-first pass-through, `SA-0MSKB6VJA005N43F`) must not exempt a pre-review child from the stage check — at minimum it must not apply to a child created during the audit run (auto-triaged `test-failure`).
- The summary text must be accurate: if any child is not in `in_review`/`done`, say so and produce "Ready to close: No".

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A parent with any non-deleted child in `idea`/`intake_complete`/`plan_complete` reports "Ready to close: No" and names the blocking child, regardless of `inherited_pass`.
- [ ] `inherited_pass` is only applied to children in `in_review`/`done` (or explicitly exempted with a documented rationale), never to pre-review children.
- [ ] The summary's "All children are in in_review or done stage." line is only emitted when that is actually true; otherwise it names the blocking children.
- [ ] Regression test: auditing a parent whose child sits at `intake_complete` (with `inherited_pass` otherwise set) yields "Ready to close: No".

## Secondary observation (may warrant a follow-up item)
- AC5 ("Full project test suite must pass") was marked `met` by the Phase 1 model even though the runner's own suite execution was killed (exit 137). The documented fail-open semantics say execution-dependent ACs should stay `partial` on a red/error run. Confirm whether a red/killed run must force `partial` on execution-dependent ACs.

## Related Work
- `SA-0MRW0G0XZ009TU6E` — Audit runner circular dependency (child verdict blocks parent regardless of stage) — completed; the inverse problem.
- `SA-0MRL8W6V7006LH5I` — If a child audit is not ready to close then the parent must also be marked not ready to close — completed.
- `SA-0MSKB6VJA005N43F` — parent-first pass-through (`inherited_pass`).

## Key Files
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — ~4201-4214 (children-stage check), ~4333 (summary text), ~9855-9861 (`inherited_pass` assignment).
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **SA-0MRW0G0XZ009TU6E** – [CRITICAL] Audit runner has circular dependency — child audit verdict blocks parent regardless of stage (completed)
- **SA-0MSPPIC4P00849VK** – create_quality_epics.py (code-review + code_review): exact-title LIKE query (completed)
- **SA-0MQNR1I92004Z03R** – IntakeAll error recovery fails on abort, leaving items in completed+idea (contradictory state) (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` — matched: 0mskb6vja005n43f, ac5, acceptance, acs, actually (+139 more)
- `docs/dev/audit-skill-reference.md` — matched: 0mskb6vja005n43f, ac5, acceptance, acs, actually (+124 more)

# Fix inherited_pass bypass: three fixes in audit_runner.py

## Summary
The audit runner incorrectly allows `inherited_pass` to bypass the pre-review stage block, producing false-positive "Ready to close: Yes" verdicts. This task combines three related fixes in `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py`.

## Fix 1: inherited_pass assignment (line ~9897)

In the `if not parent_gaps:` branch, add a stage guard so `inherited_pass=True` is only applied to children already in `in_review` or `done` stage. Pre-review children (`idea`, `intake_complete`, `plan_complete`) must not receive `inherited_pass` — they must be audited independently.

- Code at ~9897 checks child stage before setting `inherited_pass = True`
- Only children with `stage` in `("in_review", "done")` receive `inherited_pass`
- Pre-review stage children skip the `inherited_pass` branch and proceed to independent audit
- Existing `_child_content_changed` guard is preserved

## Fix 2: all_children_reviewed check (line ~4207)

The `all_children_reviewed` check currently allows `inherited_pass` to exempt a child from the stage check:

```python
all_children_reviewed = all(
    c.get("stage") in ("in_review", "done") or c.get("inherited_pass")
    for c in active_children
)
```

Remove `or c.get("inherited_pass")` — the stage check should be independent. The `inherited_pass` flag affects the verdict, not the stage blocking logic.

- `all_children_reviewed` only checks child stages, not `inherited_pass`
- A child at `intake_complete` with `inherited_pass=True` is correctly counted as blocking
- Existing exempt-child logic (deleted, completed/done) is preserved

## Fix 3: summary text (line ~4333)

The summary unconditionally appends "All children are in in_review or done stage." when `all_children_reviewed` is true. Fix this so the line is only emitted when that statement is actually true; otherwise, the summary names the blocking children.

- The "All children are in in_review or done stage." line is only emitted when all active children are actually in those stages
- When children block closure, the summary names them
- No regression on existing "Ready to close: No" cases that already name blocking children

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All three fixes applied in `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py`
- [ ] Regression test passes (separate task SA-0MUD5OMQG0068P4I)
- [ ] No regression on existing tests
- [ ] Existing `_child_content_changed` guard preserved
- [ ] Existing exempt-child logic preserved

**Key Files:**
- `skill/audit/scripts/audit_runner.py` (~4201-4214, ~4330-4340, ~9890-9910)
